text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey has been a little off her
game
recently. She says she wants to
visit a shrine, so I
go along with her.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'll offer up a prayer today and
turn my
luck Copa-tastic! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... praying... Naturally, I came
here hoping to receive a blessing, but
my main reason for
coming was to thank
the gods!
choice_data_list: Is praying to the gods part of fen...
Is praying to the gods part of fen...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, no... But also, not no.
choice_data_list: You're grateful for being in bad s...
Are you grateful for being in bad ...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm obviously grateful when things are
going well,
but that gratitude is even
more important when
things are rough!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Saying thank you is the first step. The
power of your gratitude improves your
positive qi flow,
making it easier to
receive divine blessings. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, showing gratitude makes both
you and the other person happy, right?
Having gratitude for other people and
your surroundings is one of the main
tenets of feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It improves your qi circulation and
enriches your heart at the same time. In
doing so, the synergistic effect will
boost your luck! Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆
Super happy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right, then, let's go and show our
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've paid our respects, I kind
of want
to take a stroll around the shrine
grounds. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Each shrine has its own affinity with one
of the five elements. Think of them as
power spots rife with qi. ☆ Just walking
through them can fill you with positive
energy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... Doesn't it feel nice?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The gentle breeze, the smell of plants...
I can feel
my inner qi being harmonized.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, my body feels somehow lighter! ♪
I'm so
grateful!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You must have shown a lot of gratitude
to the
gods on my behalf, yeah, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, I have to thank you too! Thank you
for always
being there for me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Showing gratitude to each other is
the
greatest blessing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that, we happily make our way
back
while expressing our gratitude for
everything we
see on the way.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, it's starting to rain! Let's hurry
back!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew,
it's really pouring. It took ages for
my
uniform to dry too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But, it's precisely at times like these we
should be
thankful, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have to trust that my inner feng shui
will
harmonize my soul and boost my
luck, even if it's
just a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey keeps trying to
encourage herself with positive words,
but she can't seem to break
out of her
slump.
